The Docker Container Name Conflict That Broke Redeployments

Jan 19, 2026

Problem

Redeployments failed with: container name already in use.

Why This Happened

The deploy script assumed a clean host. Production never is.

Fix

Make cleanup explicit and safe:

  • Stop container if exists
  • Remove container if exists
  • Then deploy

Takeaway

If your deployment isn’t idempotent, it’s fragile.
